name: ayrshare
displayName: Ayrshare - Unified Social Media API for AI Agents
description: The unified social media API for AI agents. Publish, schedule, and analyze across 13+ networks from Claude Code, with post history for brand voice and content validation against each platform's rules before every post.

api_key.title: Ayrshare API key
api_key.description: Your Ayrshare API key, from app.ayrshare.com under Settings, then API Key. It is sent to the Ayrshare API on every call and is stored in your system's secure credential store.

profile_key.title: Profile-Key (optional)
profile_key.description: A client profile's Profile-Key, to make every call act as that client by default. Leave it empty to act on your primary profile.

x_api_key.title: X API Key (optional)
x_api_key.description: Your X Developer App's API Key (Consumer Key), needed only to post to X. Set it together with the X API Secret, or leave both empty.

x_api_secret.title: X API Secret (optional)
x_api_secret.description: Your X Developer App's API Secret (Consumer Secret), needed only to post to X. Set it together with the X API Key, or leave both empty.
